rows.jp: そして部活。

ghs.en: And then to club.

rows.jp: 友貴が結線してくれたので、テントを張って長テーブルを出して、機材を置いた。
rows.en: Tomoki did the wiring for me, so I pitched the tent, set out the long table, and put the equipment in place.

ghs.en: Thanks to Tomoki having done the wiring, I pitch a tent, take out a long table and lay out the equipment on.

rows.jp: 「あとはアンテナか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Next is the antenna, then."

rows.jp: 図面にはまだ問題点が残っている。
rows.en: There are still problems with the plans.

ghs.en: There still are problem spots left on the blueprint.

rows.jp: 放送には影響はないかも知れないが。
rows.en: They might not affect the broadcast.

ghs.en: They might just not influence the broadcast, maybe, but,

rows.jp: 部活であるからには、ちゃんと予定通りやらねば。
rows.en: But this is club work, and we have to do it right, according to plan.

ghs.en: because this is club, I should just follow the plan exactly.

rows.jp: 作業。

ghs.en: Working.

rows.jp: 気配。

ghs.en: A presence.

rows.jp: 周囲に目線を流す。

ghs.en: I pass my gaze on the surroundings.

rows.jp: 誰もいない。

ghs.en: There is no one.

rows.jp: 気のせい……ではないのかな。

ghs.en: Is this just my imagination... it isn't, is it.

rows.jp: となると、ここは危ない。高所は。
rows.en: If so, this is a bad place to be. Up high.

ghs.en: And with that, this place is now dangerous. It's high up.

rows.jp: じっと脚立の上というのも良くない。
rows.en: Staying on top of a stepladder for any length of time isn't smart either.

ghs.en: Standing still on top of the stepladder is not good either.

rows.jp: 射程距離はともかく、有効射程が２０メートルくらいとして。
rows.en: Forget maximum range. Say its effective range is about twenty meters.

ghs.en: Regardless of potential range, her effective range is around 20 meters.

rows.jp: 「もう一がんばりなんだけどな……」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Right when this thing needed one last effort, too..."

rows.jp: ちょうど先輩が来た。
rows.en: Misato arrives at just that moment.

ghs.en: And just then Senpai came.

rows.jp: 「寝坊してしまいました～」

ghs.en: Misato: "I am so much a sleepyheaaa～d."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says she overslept, a completed event explaining her late arrival. The English labels her generally sleepy instead.

highlights.text: I am so much a sleepyheaaa～d.

rows.jp: 「生活がどんどん荒れてきますね」
rows.en: “Your life is getting more chaotic by the day.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Your lifestyle is steadily getting rougher, it seems."

rows.jp: 「……ははは。言葉もないです」
rows.en: “...Ha ha ha. I can't argue with that.”

ghs.en: Misato: "...hahahah. I have no words for that."

rows.jp: 「本当、もうおしまいですよねぇ……」
rows.en: “It really is all finished, isn't it...”

ghs.en: Misato: "Truly, this is already all done is it..."
Taichi: "Eh?"

rows.jp: 「あ、テントです」

ghs.en: Misato: "Ah, a tent."

rows.jp: 「配線も終わってますよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "The wiring is also finished."

rows.jp: 「ま、まさかあなたが？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Y-, you jest, you did it?"

rows.jp: 「はい、先輩のために……」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yes, for your sake, Senpai..."

rows.jp: 「すごいですっ！　かゆいところに手が届きます！　ぺけくんのすごさはもはや―――」
rows.en: “Amazing! You think of everything! At this point, X's greatness is—”

ghs.en: Misato: "That is amazing! You managed to reach all the itchy places I could not scratch! Peke-kun, your level of Amazing is now---"

rows.jp: 「と言いたいところですが、友貴です」
rows.en: “Is what I'd like to say, but it was Tomoki.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...is what I wanted to say, but Tomoki did it."
Misato: "..."

rows.jp: まず呆れた。

ghs.en: At first she was disgusted,

rows.jp: そして驚いた。律儀だ。
rows.en: Then surprise. He really is conscientious.

ghs.en: then surprised. How conscientious.

rows.jp: 「友貴が手伝ってくれたんですか？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Has Tomoki been helping us?"

rows.jp: 「正しくは手伝わせたんですけどね」

ghs.en: Taichi: "It would be more correct to say that he was made to help, yes."

rows.jp: 「そう……でも……手伝ってくれたんですね、あの子……」
rows.en: “I see... But... he did help, didn't he...”

ghs.en: Misato: "Yes... but... he is still helping us, he is..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese expresses relief that Tomoki did help them despite the conflict. The English present progressive says he is still helping at that moment, although the work was completed earlier.

rows.jp: 安堵が浮かぶ。

ghs.en: Relief becomes visible.

rows.jp: 「良かったですね」

ghs.en: Taichi: "So glad he is."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese tells Senpai that this is good news for her. The English makes the absent Tomoki the person who is glad and uses an inverted fragment.

ghs.en: Misato: "...yes!"

rows.jp: 「ところで先輩、俺ちょっと腹くだして……交代してもらっていいですか？」
rows.en: “By the way, Misato, I've got the runs... Could you take over?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "By the way Senpai, my bowels feel a bit loose... could you relieve me, please?"

rows.jp: 「はい。ここまでやってくれたら、もう一人でもいいくらいです」
rows.en: “Of course. After you've done this much, I could practically finish it alone.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Yes. If things have gotten done this far, it seems like I will be fine alone."

rows.jp: 「てっぺんのアレ、ネジ馬鹿になってますから交換した方がいいです」
rows.en: “The screw on that thing at the top is stripped. Better replace it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "On that thing at the top, the screw got stripped so I believe it would be best to replace it."

rows.jp: 「了解です」

ghs.en: Misato: "Understood!"

rows.jp: 「……では、ちょっと闘ってきます」
rows.en: “...Then I'll go do battle for a bit.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...then, I shall go have a bit of a struggle."

rows.jp: 「ふぁいとーおー！」

ghs.en: Misato: "Fight ooon!"

rows.jp: 声援に片手で応じつつ、俺は校舎に入った。
rows.en: I give her a one-handed wave and head into the school building.

ghs.en: Responding to the encouragement with one hand, I entered inside the school building.

rows.jp: さあ。

ghs.en: So,

rows.jp: 訓練の成果を見せてもらおうじゃないか。
rows.en: Let's see the results of that training.

ghs.en: you want to show me the results of all your practice, don't you?
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says the narrator will have Kiri show him the results of her practice. The English instead attributes a desire to show him to Kiri and turns the resolve into a tag question.
ghs.remedy: let's see the results of all your practice.

highlights.text: you want to show me the results of all your practice, don't you?
